# Rise and Battle the Day

## Scripture
"Have I not commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Do not be frightened, and do not be dismayed, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go." – Joshua 1:9

## Reflection
Every morning you wake up, a battle is already underway. Not against flesh and blood, but against complacency, distraction, and the quiet pull of mediocrity. Joshua faced the same reality. Moses was dead, the Jordan stood before him, and the Promised Land was filled with giants. God's command was not "play it safe" — it was "be strong and courageous."

Notice the foundation of that command: the presence of God. Courage is not the absence of fear; it's obedience in the presence of fear because you know who stands with you. Men, our strength was never meant to be self-generated. It's rooted in the One who goes with us wherever we go.

So today, don't drift into the day. Rise with intention. Pray before you scroll. Commit your work to the Lord before you check your messages. Courage is built in small, faithful decisions — one after another — until it becomes the habit of your life. The battle belongs to the Lord, but He calls you to show up and fight.

## Daily Challenge
Before your first task today, do 20 pushups and pray: "Lord, make me strong and courageous for Your glory." Then take on your hardest task first — don't delay it.
